university.title: Egyptian Chinese University
university.summary: Established under Egyptian Presidential Decree No. 118 of 2013. ECU describes itself as a productive, technology-oriented university combining academic study with practical training and links to industry.

university.title: Practical and productive education
university.summary: The public university profile emphasizes workshops, practical skills, technology transfer, entrepreneurship and industry-oriented field training.

university.title: ECU vision
university.summary: ECU states an ambition to become a competitive, technology-based productive higher education institution with strength in research, innovation, entrepreneurship and sustainable development.

university.title: ECU mission
university.summary: The university mission stresses preparing students with personal, social and professional competencies suited to evolving labor-market needs, including opportunities to engage with modern industries.

university.title: Institutional objectives
university.summary: Official objectives include institutional capacity, distinguished teaching and learning, research and innovation, community participation, international cooperation, and quality assurance.

university.title: Chinese academic cooperation in the university profile
university.summary: The public university profile names Beijing Jiaotong University, Liaoning University and North China Electric Power University as academic affiliations.
university.editorialNote: Confirm whether each affiliation is currently active before further promotion.

university.title: Published campus addresses
university.summary: The website lists a Heliopolis branch at Gesr El Suez Street behind Tagneed Bridge, and a Nasr City branch in Al Hay Al Asher, Cairo.

facultyDetails.title: Mass Communication
facultyDetails.summary: The faculty’s public page identifies three academic departments and publishes its dean’s welcome and staff directory.

facultyLearningRecords.title: General Foundation Years
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The first two years develop foundations in communication, critical thinking and media practice before students enter specialized study paths.

facultyLearningRecords.title: Digital Journalism and Graphic Design
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The department covers digital writing and publishing, television journalism, and graphic design for journalism, combining responsible reporting with visual communication.

facultyLearningRecords.title: Audio-Visual Production
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The department covers cinematography, editing, broadcast production, sound, dubbing, voice-over and applied audiovisual projects.

facultyLearningRecords.title: Integrated Marketing Communication
facultyLearningRecords.summary: The program combines digital marketing communication with public relations and corporate communication, with practical projects in campaigns and reputation management.

academicAreas.title: Engineering and Technology areas
academicAreas.summary: The official admissions portal describes study areas including construction, energy and renewable energy, software and IT engineering, mechatronics, and petroleum and gas engineering.
academicAreas.editorialNote: Confirm formal degree titles before publishing a programme catalogue.

academicAreas.title: Computing and Information Systems subjects
academicAreas.summary: The official admissions portal describes computer science, information systems, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and data science as learning areas. These are not necessarily separately awarded degrees.

academicAreas.title: Arts and Design areas
academicAreas.summary: The official admissions portal identifies areas including film and television production, interior and furniture design, visual arts, graphic design and multimedia, industrial product design and fashion design.
academicAreas.editorialNote: Confirm the university’s current formal programme taxonomy.

admissions.title: Egyptian Secondary School Certificate
admissions.summary: Published requirements refer applicants to the minimum admission percentages announced by Egypt’s Supreme Council of Private Universities. The percentage that applies to your intake and faculty is confirmed by ECU Admissions.
requirements: Meet the officially announced admission thresholds for the relevant intake and faculty.
documents: Original secondary school certificate
Original birth certificate
Copy of national ID for Egyptian applicants, or passport
Six recent passport-size photographs with white background
Military forms for Egyptian male applicants where applicable
admissions.editorialNote: Do not infer current minimum percentages from archived guidance.

admissions.title: Secondary Certificates from Arab Countries
admissions.summary: The published policy distinguishes scientific certificate requirements for Physical Therapy, Pharmacy and Engineering from other certificate pathways for Economics and International Trade.
requirements: Published guidance describes science-stream eligibility for specific science and engineering faculties.
The minimum accepted percentage is set by current official decisions for each intake.
documents: Original certificate authenticated by appropriate diplomatic or foreign-affairs authorities
Country-specific evidence or recommendation letters where applicable
Original birth certificate
Copy of national ID for Egyptian applicants, or passport
Six recent passport-size photographs with white background
Military forms for Egyptian male applicants where applicable
admissions.editorialNote: Eligibility for each faculty requires current confirmation.

admissions.title: IGCSE
admissions.summary: The official page describes eight qualifying O-Level subjects, with additional advanced mathematics for Engineering and faculty-specific subject requirements.
requirements: Published guidance lists eight qualifying O-Level subjects.
Confirm the accepted grades and exam-session rules for the current intake with ECU Admissions.
documents: Certified IGCSE result slips
Proof of 12 years of schooling or specified equivalent
Original birth certificate
Copy of national ID for Egyptian applicants, or passport
Six recent passport-size photographs with white background
Military forms for Egyptian male applicants where applicable
admissions.editorialNote: Verify current equivalency and thresholds before treating this as current policy.

admissions.title: American Diploma
admissions.summary: The public guidance describes transcript subjects, grade distributions and test requirements, with additional mathematics or examinations for some faculties.
requirements: Published guidance describes eight qualifying school subjects and grade-level conditions.
Engineering may require advanced mathematics or additional examinations.
Confirm the current test policies and equivalency rules with ECU Admissions.
documents: Authenticated final high-school transcript
Applicable standardized examination records and authentication
Proof of 12 years of schooling
Original birth certificate
Copy of national ID for Egyptian applicants, or passport
Six recent passport-size photographs with white background
Military forms for Egyptian male applicants where applicable
admissions.editorialNote: Historic SAT/ACT/EST scores must not be treated as current eligibility rules without approval.

admissions.title: International Baccalaureate
admissions.summary: ECU’s public page describes six subjects including three Higher Level subjects, with faculty-specific science and mathematics requirements.
requirements: Published guidance describes six subjects including three Higher Level subjects.
Engineering and Computer/IT-related disciplines may require HL Mathematics and Physics.
Confirm current minimum score and equivalency standards.
documents: Authenticated final IB transcript and diploma
Proof of 12 years of schooling
Original birth certificate
Copy of national ID for Egyptian applicants, or passport
Six recent passport-size photographs with white background
Military forms for Egyptian male applicants where applicable
admissions.editorialNote: Current acceptance must be confirmed with ECU Admissions.

admissions.title: German Abitur
admissions.summary: Published guidance describes Grade 12 completion and a transcript including seven subjects.
requirements: Complete Grade 12 under the published qualification framework.
Confirm accepted subjects and marks for the current intake.
documents: Authenticated Abitur certificate and translation where necessary
Proof of 12 years of schooling
Original birth certificate
Copy of national ID for Egyptian applicants, or passport
Six recent passport-size photographs with white background
Military forms for Egyptian male applicants where applicable
admissions.editorialNote: Exact scores and certification procedures require current confirmation.

archivedStories.title: Mass Communication quality and academic pathways awareness day
archivedStories.summary: A student awareness activity covered quality culture, student rights and academic pathways in media.

archivedStories.title: First-year Mass Communication visit to Akhbar Al-Youm
archivedStories.summary: Students visited the media organization to learn about newsroom operations, libraries, archives and digital publishing processes.

archivedStories.title: Mass Communication student visit to Grand Egyptian Museum
archivedStories.summary: The faculty’s public activities listing records a student visit to the Grand Egyptian Museum.

archivedStories.title: Advertising industry workshop
archivedStories.summary: The Faculty of Mass Communication hosted an academic workshop examining advertising and digital marketing in Egypt and the Arab world.

archivedStories.title: Press cartooning workshop
archivedStories.summary: The faculty hosted a workshop about cartoon art and its evolution across print and digital media.

archivedStories.title: Chinese-language book handover ceremony
archivedStories.summary: ECU’s official photo gallery records a handover ceremony for Chinese books sponsored by Sinopec.

archivedStories.title: Arts and Design digital technology workshop
archivedStories.summary: ECU’s gallery records an Arts and Design workshop focused on contemporary systems and digital technologies.

archivedStories.title: One Health veterinary research workshop visit
archivedStories.summary: ECU’s official photo gallery describes a University of Liverpool College of Veterinary Medicine research-team visit connected with a One Health workshop.

archivedStories.title: Our Students from Shanghai University in China
archivedStories.summary: Students of the Faculty of Physical Therapy at ECU trained at Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, with postgraduate study and a Chinese acupuncture specialisation discussed for graduating students.

archivedStories.title: Cooperation protocol with Cairo Pharmacists Syndicate
archivedStories.summary: The Faculty of Economics and International Trade signed a cooperation protocol with the Cairo Pharmacists Syndicate to open enrolment opportunities for syndicate members in the faculty's professional master's programmes.
